# Local vendor-document cache

Public vendor PDFs are downloaded here for local investigation. They are
ignored by Git because redistribution terms and file sizes vary. Rebuild the
cache from the URLs and SHA-256 values in [`../sources.tsv`](../sources.tsv).

The committed notes never depend on proprietary firmware or captured watch
pixels. A missing local PDF is recorded as `web-only` in the source index when
the official page is readable but the vendor download endpoint is gated or
unreliable from the local network.
